simulation_brief.summary: Awards-race simulation centered on whether fictionalized Nominee S wins Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards. T0 conditions indicate Nominee S has the highest nomination count and strong public conversation around genre recognition and representational impact, while at least one competing prestige drama by an established auteur appears more historically aligned with Academy Best Picture preferences. Preferential ballot dynamics create uncertainty because broad consensus may outperform intense but narrower enthusiasm. Terminal resolution is only the official Best Picture winner announcement.
uncertainty_notes: Nomination lead does not mechanically determine Best Picture.
Relative strength of consensus support versus passionate first-place support is uncertain.
Evidence is sparse on exact competitor slate, guild momentum, and Academy factional splits.
simulation_brief.fictionalization_note: Public-facing award entities remain generic or fictionalized per instruction.
